topic: Partial Differential Equations: Modeling Change in Space and Time

sections.title: From One to Many: The PDE Intuition
lecture_lines: ODEs track changes over one variable, like time.
But reality often involves multiple variables, like position.
PDEs describe how systems evolve in space and time.
animations: Draw a vertical rectangle (#FF0000) representing a thermometer. Label horizontal axis 't' (#FFFFFF).
Transform the rectangle into a 2D grid of small squares (#FFFFFF) to represent space.
Color central squares red (#FF0000) and outer squares blue (#0000FF). Animate heat spreading.

sections.title: Prerequisite Kit: The Partial Derivative
lecture_lines: Partial derivatives measure change while holding other variables constant.
Imagine hiking a mountain along a single compass direction.
We isolate one dimension to understand complex multidimensional shapes.
animations: Draw a 3D wireframe mesh (#666666). Place a small yellow sphere (#FFFF00) on the surface.
Draw a green tangent line (#00FF00) along the x-direction through the sphere.
Draw a cyan tangent line (#00FFFF) along the y-direction through the sphere.

sections.title: The Heat Equation: Modeling Diffusion
lecture_lines: The heat equation describes how temperature spreads through space.
Time change depends on the curvature of spatial temperature.
High curvature means heat flows quickly into colder regions.
Over time, temperature gradients flatten toward a steady state.
This parabolic behavior models diffusion in many physical systems.
animations: Show a blue rectangle (#0000FF) with an orange circle (#FFA500) labeled 'Heat Source'.
Display formula: d u / d t = alpha * d2 u / d x2. Highlight d u / d t in yellow (#FFFF00).
Plot a sharp red bell curve (#FF0000) over the blue rectangle.
Draw white arrows (#FFFFFF) pointing from the peak outward.
Animate the bell curve (#FF0000) flattening into a horizontal line.

sections.title: The Wave Equation: Modeling Vibration
lecture_lines: The wave equation models oscillations like a plucked string.
Acceleration at a point depends on local spatial tension.
This creates disturbances that propagate as traveling waves.
Energy moves through the medium without displacing the matter.
Hyperbolic equations describe this dynamic, time-dependent behavior.
animations: Show a horizontal line (#FFFFFF). Display wave equation formula in white.
Animate a brown arc (#A52A2A) pulling and releasing the line center.
Highlight a single yellow dot (#FFFF00) on the line moving up and down.
Animate a cyan sine pulse (#00FFFF) traveling from left to right.
Add green vectors (#00FF00) showing curvature at the wave peak.

sections.title: The Big Three: Classification of PDEs
lecture_lines: PDEs fall into three main types based on behavior.
Elliptic equations describe steady-state systems and equilibrium.
Parabolic equations model diffusion and spreading over time.
Hyperbolic equations represent waves and transport phenomena.
This classification helps us choose the right solving strategy.
animations: Display 'PDE Classification' in white (#FFFFFF) at the top.
Show 'Elliptic: Equilibrium' (#00FF00) next to a static smooth surface.
Show 'Parabolic: Diffusion' (#FFFF00) with a spreading Gaussian curve.
Show 'Hyperbolic: Waves' (#00FFFF) with two pulses moving in opposite directions.
Display 'Fundamental Physics' (#FFFFFF) below the three examples.

sections.title: The 'Walls' of the Math: Boundary Conditions
lecture_lines: Boundaries define the physical limits of our PDE system.
Dirichlet conditions fix the value at the boundary's edge.
Neumann conditions specify the slope or flux across boundaries.
animations: Draw a horizontal white segment (#FFFFFF) with red circles (#FF0000) at endpoints.
Label the endpoints 'Dirichlet: Fixed Value' (#FF0000).
Replace circles with green tangent lines (#00FF00). Label 'Neumann: Fixed Slope'.

sections.title: Conclusion: The Language of the Universe
lecture_lines: PDEs power weather forecasts and modern engineering designs.
They are the mathematical foundation for describing physical reality.
Mastering them unlocks the secrets of a changing world.
